title: Pip Crosses the Pond
note: b418 — Phase 4 (Learning) — longer words with two sounds blended at the start (st, sw, tr), stretch practice.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow standing on a grassy bank, looking across a round garden pond to the far side.
Pip the sparrow pulling a long, flat brown stick to the edge of a round garden pond.
Pip the sparrow balanced on a flat brown stick as it floats a little way out onto a round garden pond.
A flat brown stick spinning and tipping on rippling pond water, Pip the sparrow wobbling to stay on.
Pip the sparrow tumbling off a stick into a round garden pond with a big splash.
Pip the sparrow standing on a grassy bank, feathers soaked and dripping with water.
Pip the sparrow pulling a short, flat brown log to the edge of a round garden pond.
A flat brown log floating steadily on the still water of a round garden pond.
Pip the sparrow riding a floating brown log past a clump of tall green reeds at the edge of a pond.
Pip the sparrow stepping off a log onto green grass on the far side of a pond, feathers damp, looking pleased.
